description: This file contains unit tests for the BasketService's DeleteBasketAsync method within the eShopOnWeb application. It verifies that the basket repository's delete method is invoked once during basket deletion.

classes.name: DeleteBasket
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the deletion functionality of BasketService in the BasketServiceTests namespace. It tests that the delete operation is invoked exactly once.

methods.name: ShouldInvokeBasketRepositoryDeleteAsyncOnce
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that creates a basket, adds items, retrieves it via the repository mock, and verifies that the DeleteAsync method is called exactly once.
